Plot some QC plots to define that everything ran correctly

Source: R/get_QC_plots.R
get_QC_plots.Rd

Plot data to visualize immediate trends. This function expects data that has been processed through make_count_dataframe() and change_data_format_to_longer() to ensure the correct data structure for plotting.

Usage

get_QC_plots(
  .data,
  patient_column_name = "PID",
  colors = unname(drugsens_palette),
  save_plots = FALSE,
  folder_name = NULL,
  x_plot_var = "Treatment_complete",
  isolate_a_specific_patient = NULL,
  compare_to_control = FALSE,
  control_treatment_name = "Control",
  stat_method = c("wilcox", "t.test"),
  p_adjust_method = "BH",
  pvalue_label = c("p.adj.signif", "p.signif", "p.adj.format", "p.format")
)

Arguments

.data

The preprocessed data (after running make_count_dataframe() and change_data_format_to_longer()) merged data.frame that should be visualized

patient_column_name

The PID's column name in the merged data.frame (defaults to "PID")

colors

A character vector of colors to supply to personalize the plot, defaults to unname(drugsens_palette) (8-color CVD-safe palette).

save_plots

A Boolean value indicating if the plots should be saved or not (default is FALSE)

folder_name

Directory where plots are saved when save_plots = TRUE. Defaults to file.path(tempdir(), "figures") when NULL.

x_plot_var

A string indicating the treatment's full name for the QC plots (default is "Treatment_complete")

isolate_a_specific_patient

A string indicating the patient name to isolate for single plot case (default is NULL)

compare_to_control

Logical, whether to compute and display statistical comparisons against control_treatment_name within each marker facet. Defaults to FALSE.

control_treatment_name

Value in x_plot_var identifying the control/vehicle group when compare_to_control = TRUE. Defaults to "Control".

stat_method

Statistical test used when compare_to_control = TRUE: "wilcox" (default) or "t.test".

p_adjust_method

Multiple-testing correction method passed to stats::p.adjust() across treatments within each marker facet. Supports "BH" (Benjamini-Hochberg FDR, default), "bonferroni", "holm", "fdr", "hochberg", "hommel", "BY", or "none".

pvalue_label

Format for p-value annotations: "p.adj.signif" (adjusted *, **, ***, ns, default), "p.signif" (unadjusted), "p.adj.format", or "p.format".

Value

When save_plots = FALSE, returns a ggplot object (if a single patient is plotted) or a named list of ggplot objects (keyed by patient ID). When save_plots = TRUE, invisibly returns the named list of ggplot objects after saving PDFs to disk.

Examples

# \donttest{
# First process example data
example_path <- system.file("extdata/to_merge/", package = "drugsens")
raw_data <- data_binding(path_to_the_projects_folder = example_path)
#> Reading file: /Users/flalom/Library/R/arm64/4.6/library/drugsens/extdata/to_merge//A8759_drug1..conc2.csv
#> Reading file: /Users/flalom/Library/R/arm64/4.6/library/drugsens/extdata/to_merge//A8759_drug1__conc1.csv
#> Reading file: /Users/flalom/Library/R/arm64/4.6/library/drugsens/extdata/to_merge//B36_Ascites_rep_cont.csv
#> Reading file: /Users/flalom/Library/R/arm64/4.6/library/drugsens/extdata/to_merge//B37_Ascites_Pacli.csv
#> Reading file: /Users/flalom/Library/R/arm64/4.6/library/drugsens/extdata/to_merge//B38_Ascites_GP.csv
#> Reading file: /Users/flalom/Library/R/arm64/4.6/library/drugsens/extdata/to_merge//B39_Ascites_REP_nir.csv
count_data <- make_count_dataframe(raw_data)
processed_data <- change_data_format_to_longer(count_data)

# Create and save plots to temporary directory
temp_dir <- file.path(tempdir(), "qc_plots")
get_QC_plots(
  processed_data,
  save_plots = TRUE,
  folder_name = temp_dir
)
